symbols.name: close
symbols.summary: Stop recorders and their subprocesses before closing the app's sessions.

symbols.name: needs_transcode_cached
symbols.summary:
Sync, race-free: True if this channel must be transcoded for web playback.
Known set is authoritative; probe results are remembered after the first record.

symbols.name: touch
symbols.summary:
Mark a channel as wanted. play=True means actually tuned (may start a transcode);
play=False is a pre-warm (never burns an encode slot).

symbols.name: _needs_transcode
symbols.summary:
Fetch one segment and decide if the channel needs transcoding for web playback
(MP2/AC3/aac_latm audio, or non-h264 video like HEVC). Cached after the first probe.

symbols.name: _ffmpeg_proxy_url
symbols.summary: Webshare residential proxy URL (with embedded auth) for ffmpeg's http_proxy env.

symbols.name: _record_ffmpeg
symbols.summary:
Run a long-lived ffmpeg that ingests the live stream and writes continuous AAC HLS.
ffmpeg owns segmentation + timestamps, so segments splice cleanly in HLS.js.

symbols.name: _rewrite_ff
symbols.summary: Point ffmpeg's segment lines at our /dvrseg/ endpoint.

symbols.name: playlist
symbols.summary: Build a sliding-window media playlist over the ring buffer (live, seekable).

symbols.name: yt_player
symbols.summary:
On-demand YouTube channel player page (IFrame API, always-on rotation).
Loaded by the web iframe and the native WebView. muted=1 for web (browser autoplay),
muted=0 for the TV app (sound on).

symbols.name: personalized_m3u
symbols.summary: Generate a flat M3U pointing every channel at our /master.m3u8 endpoint.

symbols.name: _upstream_get_text
symbols.summary: Returns (body, final_url).

symbols.name: channel_dvr
symbols.summary:
DVR playlist: a sliding 15-min window over the recorded ring buffer.
Starts the recorder on first request (smart-dumping). Falls back to live master
while the buffer is still filling so the user never sees an error.

symbols.name: channel_warm
symbols.summary: Start recording a channel so it's instant when tuned. Called on hover/prewarm.

symbols.name: app_latest
symbols.summary: Self-update manifest for the sideloaded Android TV app.

symbols.name: channel_logo
symbols.summary:
Serve channel logo from the local catalog/logos/ directory.
Falls back to a 1x1 transparent PNG so the client never sees a 404 noise.

symbols.name: webfont
symbols.summary: Self-hosted woff2 fonts — no external Google Fonts round-trip → no FOUC.

symbols.name: country_flag
symbols.summary: Rounded country/region flag SVGs (locale icons). Reliable on TV unlike emoji flags.

symbols.name: channel_thumb
symbols.summary: Serve the latest live thumbnail (captured by thumb_loop every 10 min). 404 until captured.

symbols.name: mirror_id
symbols.summary: Stable short id from url.

symbols.name: any_mirror
symbols.summary:
Best available mirror for an ACTIVE recorder — prefer healthy, but never hard-stop
a live recording just because the prober transiently soured every mirror. The recorder's
own fetch is the real liveness test, so fall back to the least-bad option.

symbols.name: _parse_master
symbols.summary: Return list of variants sorted by bandwidth desc.

symbols.name: probe_mirror
symbols.summary: Mutates mirror in place with current health state.

symbols.name: probe_catalog
symbols.summary: Probe every mirror of every channel, in parallel batches.

symbols.name: capture_thumb_via_self
symbols.summary: Let ffmpeg ingest our own HLS endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8765. It handles GOP + keyframes properly.

symbols.name: capture_thumb
symbols.summary: Fetch latest segment of mirror, extract a frame with ffmpeg → JPEG 640x360.

symbols.name: thumb_loop
symbols.summary: Every THUMB_INTERVAL seconds, capture a fresh thumbnail for each healthy channel.

symbols.name: prober_loop
symbols.summary: Run forever: probe + sleep + dump snapshot.

symbols.name: b64url_encode
symbols.summary: Issue an opaque server-owned upstream ticket.

symbols.name: b64url_decode
symbols.summary: Resolve only a ticket issued by this server.

symbols.name: rewrite_master
symbols.summary: Rewrite #EXT-X-STREAM-INF target lines to point at our /v/ endpoint.

symbols.name: rewrite_variant
symbols.summary: Rewrite a media playlist: segment lines + #EXT-X-MAP + #EXT-X-KEY URI.

symbols.name: webshare_proxy_url
symbols.summary: Returns just the proxy URL (no embedded auth). Pair with webshare_proxy_auth().

symbols.name: webshare_proxy_auth
symbols.summary: Returns aiohttp.BasicAuth for the country code, or None if no proxy is set.

symbols.name: yt_loop
symbols.summary: Periodic background refresh of every YouTube channel's recent-video list (~hourly).

symbols.name: is_live
symbols.summary:
A YouTube channel is 'live' if we have something to play: a PL… playlist, or cached
RSS video ids. An empty UC channel (RSS unreachable / channel dark) reads as down so a
dead tile self-removes instead of opening into a black player.

symbols.name: targets
symbols.summary: Every link target on one line, unwrapped and stripped of its title.
